references.text: The Lord chose the Levites from the children of Israel as His own, in place of all the firstborn in Israel.
The Levites were taken as a substitute for all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
The continuation of the text describing how the Levites were set apart and cleansed for service.
The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the Lord.
The principle of washing clothes and purifying oneself as preparation to meet the Lord.
Moses brought forward Aaron and his sons and washed them with water as part of the consecration ritual.
The New Testament compares Levitical cleansing with Christ's blood, which cleanses the conscience.
